Geographic data: Natural Earth, 1:110m land polygons.
Natural Earth data is in the public domain.
Primary source: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/110m-physical-vectors/110m-land/
GeoJSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/master/geojson/ne_110m_land.geojson
Generated assets: earth-texture.png, land-mask.png, land-points.json, ocean-points.json.
Texture: equirectangular, longitude -180 at left, +180 at right, latitude +90 at top.
Point coordinates: x=cos(lat)*sin(lon), y=sin(lat), z=cos(lat)*cos(lon).

World map boundaries: Natural Earth, 1:50m Admin 0 - Countries.
Natural Earth data is in the public domain.
Primary source: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/50m-cultural-vectors/50m-admin-0-countries-2/
GeoJSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/master/geojson/ne_50m_admin_0_countries.geojson
File: world-countries.geojson (unmodified upstream data).
World map searchable places: cities.json, 558 entries, including the retained first 266 city nodes.
The world map and 3D globe load the same 558 searchable places, each with an original introduction.
Fields: name (Chinese), en (English), lat (degrees), lon (degrees), region (Chinese continent).
China city metadata additionally includes country, province, timezone (IANA), aliases, capital, kind and description.
Regions: Asia, Europe, Africa, North America, South America, Oceania. Istanbul is classified in Europe; Honolulu in North America.
The world map is a geographic visualization. Upstream feature properties and geometry are preserved.

Font: Manrope variable font, Google Fonts repository.
Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/manrope
File: manrope.ttf (unmodified Manrope[wght].ttf from upstream).
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see LICENSE-manrope.txt.

3D Earth imagery: unmodified planet textures from the official three.js r160 examples.
Upstream directory: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r160/examples/textures/planets
Pinned upstream files (all 2048 x 1024, equirectangular):
earth-day.jpg <- earth_atmos_2048.jpg
earth-normal.jpg <- earth_normal_2048.jpg
earth-specular.jpg <- earth_specular_2048.jpg
earth-night.png <- earth_lights_2048.png
earth-clouds.png <- earth_clouds_2048.png (RGBA cloud transparency)
Download base: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/r160/examples/textures/planets/
The upstream three.js repository carries the MIT license, included as LICENSE-threejs.txt.
Original imagery credit is not separately stated alongside these upstream files; no claim of current weather or real-time city lighting is made.
Texture orientation: longitude -180 degrees at left, +180 at right, latitude +90 at top. Compatible with the project's geographic UV convention.

Denser 3D globe point assets: land-points-dense.json and ocean-points-dense.json.
Regenerated 2026-10-17 from the existing Natural Earth land-mask.png using seeded uniform sphere proposals and minimum-distance rejection (radii 1.004 land and 1.002 ocean).
Retains 86,337 land and 43,185 ocean points. Equal-area sampling avoids polar crowding; minimum-distance random sampling avoids latitude bands and spiral moire.
Reproduction script: qa/generate_equal_area_earth.py. No geographic boundaries or city coordinates are changed.
Globe coastline contours use the existing ne_110m_land.geojson (Natural Earth, public domain).
Point coordinates retain x=cos(lat)*sin(lon), y=sin(lat), z=cos(lat)*cos(lon).
Dense city light locations: Natural Earth, 1:50m Populated Places, public domain.
Primary source: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/50m-cultural-vectors/50m-populated-places/
GeoJSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/master/geojson/ne_50m_populated_places.geojson
Cached source: qa/sources/ne_50m_populated_places.geojson; SHA-256 da4662b7bbfeb897d02f228c5839131dce27acff5717630f91ccff4f67828ee7.
Generated file: dense-city-lights.json, 500 cities selected from actual upstream coordinates.
Selection retains national capitals, minimum continent coverage, then largest POP_MAX values.
The population field retains Natural Earth's historical metropolitan POP_MAX estimate.
These decorative city lights do not indicate live electricity or weather conditions.
The 500 former decorative light locations now resolve to named, selectable entries in cities.json.
The 3D globe does not render a separate, noninteractive city-light cloud. It draws all named pins in one Canvas pass.


Additional world map city coordinates (2026-10-15):
27 added cities use Natural Earth 1:50m Populated Places LATITUDE/LONGITUDE fields, public domain.
Primary source: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/50m-cultural-vectors/50m-populated-places/
GeoJSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/master/geojson/ne_50m_populated_places.geojson
Cached source: qa/sources/ne_50m_populated_places.geojson.
These include Baoshan (Yunnan), latitude 25.119977, longitude 99.150010, upstream NAME=Baoshan and ADM1NAME=Yunnan.
The original 68 city names, English labels, coordinates and continent fields are retained.
Shenyang's English display label normalizes the upstream Shenyeng spelling; Xining's province label is Qinghai.
Haikou coordinates: latitude 20.034210, longitude 110.346510, GeoNames ID 1809078.
Source and attribution: GeoNames, https://www.geonames.org/1809078/haikou.html (accessed 2026-10-15).
GeoNames data: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
GeoNames terms: https://www.geonames.org/about.html
Haikou coordinates are used without modification; city display metadata is authored for this project.

World capitals and related government centers (reference checked 2026-10-15):
Scope: 193 United Nations member states plus the Holy See and the State of Palestine (195 countries).
There are 205 capital/center markers, with distinct capital, legislative, judicial and government-seat roles.
Scope references: https://www.un.org/en/about-us/member-states and https://www.un.org/en/about-us/non-member-states
Coordinate and IANA timezone source: GeoNames cities500, https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/cities500.zip
GeoNames data: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Attribution and terms: GeoNames, https://www.geonames.org/about.html
Most newly added coordinates are used without modification from the 2026-10-15 GeoNames snapshot.
The East Jerusalem marker is approximate, near the Old City; it does not define a boundary or resolve city status.
The first 96 established city nodes keep their order and original coordinates; 35 are reused for matching physical capitals/centers.
Country names and continent metadata also reference Natural Earth 1:10m Admin 0 - Countries (public domain):
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/master/geojson/ne_10m_admin_0_countries.geojson
Chinese city names are reviewed against Natural Earth 1:10m Populated Places (public domain) and corrected display names:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/master/geojson/ne_10m_populated_places.geojson
City descriptions are original project copy. The original 36 China city descriptions and provincial metadata are retained.
Runtime coverage, roles and source URLs: capitals-meta.json. The larger source snapshots remain in qa/sources only.
The older capital flag describes Chinese provincial centers; nationalCapital separately marks the capital/center collection.
Kingston (Jamaica) and Kingstown (Saint Vincent and the Grenadines) are distinct nodes despite their shared Chinese display name.

All-place introduction update (2026-10-17):
558 selectable places; 558 individually authored Chinese introductions; 47 island and regional points.
All first 266 IDs, names, coordinates, capital roles and the existing 240 introductions are retained.
The former 500 decorative source lights are matched to the catalog; source-to-node mapping is in qa/all-point-coverage.json.
Additional populated island centers use GeoNames cities500 (2026-10-15 snapshot), CC BY 4.0, attribution above.
Seven remote island / geographic markers use approximate locality coordinates, not city boundaries or claims of capital status.
Country / region labels are geographic display metadata. nationalCapital flags and the 195-country capital scope are unchanged.
No national-capital flag is assigned to the added island or regional points.
Runtime coverage: places-meta.json. Migration: qa/extend_point_catalog.py and qa/apply_all_point_copy.py.
Original Chinese copy: qa/all-point-copy.tsv. Island background references are listed in qa/sources/ALL_POINT_INTRO_SOURCES.md.

Performance assets (assets/optimized/): WebP derivatives of the credited textures; signed 16-bit packed positions, scale 30000, with every original particle retained.
The world-map derivative retains all 242 country/territory features, polygon components and holes. Coastlines are simplified with topology preservation at 0.012 degrees and rounded to four decimals for screen display.
Generated by scripts/optimize-assets.py; the original source assets remain in the repository.
